messages.english:
<white>Welcome!</white>

<cyan>You can be:</cyan>
messages.translation:
<white>欢迎！</white>

<cyan>你可以选择：</cyan>

messages.english: Esc - Quit
messages.translation: Esc - 退出

messages.english: * - Random hints mode character
messages.translation: * - 随机选择新手模式角色

messages.english: See you next game!
messages.translation: 下局再见！

messages.english: Remember to rest between fights and to enter unexplored terrain with full health and magic. Ideally you should retreat into areas you've already explored and cleared of monsters; resting on the edge of the explored terrain increases the chances of your rest being interrupted by wandering monsters. To rest, press <w>5</w> or <w>Shift-numpad 5</w><tiles>, or <w>click the rest button</w></tiles>.
messages.translation: 记得在战斗之间休息，并在生命和魔力全满时探索未知区域。最好退回已经探索、清除了怪物的区域；在已探索区域的边缘休息，更容易被游荡的怪物打断。按 <w>5</w> 或 <w>Shift-numpad 5</w><tiles>，或<w>点击休息按钮</w></tiles>即可休息。

messages.english: Also, berserking might help you not to lose so much health in the first place. To use your abilities press <w>a</w>.
messages.translation: 此外，狂暴或许能让你在战斗中少损失一些生命。按 <w>a</w> 使用能力。

messages.english: Your console settings allowing, you'll always see a list of monsters somewhere on the screen.
messages.translation: 如果终端设置允许，屏幕上会一直显示怪物列表。

messages.english: You can gain information about it by pressing <w>x</w> and moving the cursor over the monster, and read the monster description by then pressing <w>v</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>x</w> 并将光标移到怪物上即可查看信息，再按 <w>v</w> 阅读怪物说明。

messages.english: To attack this monster with your wielded weapon, just move into it.
messages.translation: 要用手持武器攻击这只怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: Note that as long as there's a non-friendly monster in view you won't be able to automatically move to distant squares, to avoid death by misclicking.
messages.translation: 注意：只要视野内有非友好的怪物，你就无法自动移动到远处的方格，以免误点致死。

messages.english: However, as a hunter you will want to deal with it using your bow. If you have a look at your shortbow from your <w>i</w>nventory, you'll find an explanation of how to do this.
messages.translation: 不过，作为猎手，你应当用弓对付它。在物品栏（<w>i</w>）中查看短弓，即可了解操作方法。

messages.english:
First <w>w</w>ield it, then follow the instructions.<tiles>
As a short-cut you can also <w>right-click</w> on your shortbow to read its description, and <w>left-click</w> to wield it.</tiles>
messages.translation:
先按 <w>w</w> 持用它，再按照说明操作。<tiles>
也可以<w>右键点击</w>短弓阅读说明，<w>左键点击</w>持用。</tiles>

messages.english: <tiles>Clicking with your <w>right mouse button</w> on your shortbow will also let you read its description.</tiles>
messages.translation: <tiles>用<w>鼠标右键</w>点击短弓也能阅读说明。</tiles>

messages.english: However, as a conjurer you will want to deal with it using magic. If you look at the help entry for the <w>M</w>emorisation screen you'll find an explanation of how to do this.
messages.translation: 不过，作为塑能师，你应当用魔法对付它。查看法术记忆界面（<w>M</w>）的帮助说明，即可了解操作方法。

messages.english: Stairs
messages.translation: 楼梯

messages.english: Escape hatch
messages.translation: 逃生通道

messages.english: Branch stairs
messages.translation: 分支楼梯

messages.english: Portal
messages.translation: 传送门

messages.english: Closed door
messages.translation: 关闭的门

messages.english: Runed door
messages.translation: 符文门

messages.english: This screen shows your character's set of talents. You can gain new abilities via certain items, through religion or by way of mutations. Activation of an ability usually comes at a cost, e.g. Magic power. Press '<w>!</w>' or '<w>?</w>' to toggle between ability selection and description.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色拥有的能力。某些物品、信仰和变异可以赋予你新的能力。发动能力通常需要付出代价，例如消耗魔力。按“<w>!</w>”或“<w>?</w>”可在能力选择与说明之间切换。

messages.english: This screen shows the skill set of your character. The number next to the skill is your current level, the higher the better. <w>Training</w> displays training percentages. <w>Costs</w> displays relative training costs. <w>Targets</w> displays skill training targets. You can toggle which skills to train by pressing their slot letters. A <darkgrey>grey</darkgrey> skill will not be trained and ease the training of others.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色的技能。技能旁的数字是当前等级，越高越好。<w>训练</w>显示训练百分比，<w>花费</w>显示相对训练花费，<w>目标</w>显示技能训练目标。按技能对应的字母可切换是否训练该技能。<darkgrey>灰色</darkgrey>技能不会被训练，因此其他技能可获得更多训练。

messages.english: The training percentage (in <brown>brown</brown>) shows the relative amount of the experience gained which will be used to train each skill. It is automatically set depending on which skills you have used recently. Disabling a skill sets the training rate to 0.
messages.translation: 训练百分比（<brown>棕色</brown>）表示获得的经验值中，用于训练各项技能的相对份额。它会根据你最近使用的技能自动设置。关闭某项技能的训练会将其训练比例设为 0。

messages.english: The training cost (in <cyan>cyan</cyan>) shows the experience cost to raise the given skill one level, relative to the cost of raising an aptitude zero skill from level zero to level one.
messages.translation: 训练花费（<cyan>青色</cyan>）表示该技能提升一级所需的经验值，相对于天资为零的技能从零级升到一级所需经验值的倍数。

messages.english: Press the letter of a skill to set a training target. When the target is reached a message will appear and the training of the skill will be disabled.
messages.translation: 按技能对应的字母可设置训练目标。达到目标时会显示消息，并停止训练该技能。

messages.english: This screen shows the skill set of your character. Press the letter of a skill to read its description, or press <w>?</w> again to return to the skill selection.
messages.translation: 此界面显示角色的技能。按技能对应的字母可阅读说明，再按 <w>?</w> 返回技能选择。

messages.english: This screen shows the spells in your spell library. From here you can memorise spells by selecting them, as well as view spell descriptions, search for them, and organize them. As a conjurer, you start with five memorisable spells, and one already memorised: Magic Dart. (To view memorised spells, you can exit this menu and select <w>I</w>.)
messages.translation: 此界面显示法术库中的法术。你可以选择法术进行记忆，也可以查看说明、搜索和整理法术。塑能师开局有五个可记忆的法术，以及一个已记忆的法术：魔法飞弹。（要查看已记忆的法术，可以退出此菜单并按 <w>I</w>。）

messages.english: A spell that isn't <darkgray>grayed out</darkgray> or <lightred>forbidden</lightred> can be memorised right away by selecting it at this menu.
messages.translation: 没有<darkgray>变灰</darkgray>或被<lightred>禁止</lightred>的法术，可以在此菜单中选择并立即记忆。

messages.english: When wielded, some weapons (such as this one) offer certain abilities you can activate.
messages.translation: 某些武器（例如这件）在持用时会赋予你可发动的能力。

messages.english: You can wield this weapon with <w>%</w>, or use <w>%</w> to switch between the weapons in slot a and b. (Use <w>%i</w> to adjust item slots.)
messages.translation: 按 <w>%</w> 可持用这件武器，按 <w>%</w> 可在物品栏 a 和 b 两个位置的武器之间切换。（按 <w>%i</w> 可调整物品位置。）

messages.english: To attack a monster, you can simply walk into it.
messages.translation: 要攻击怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: Because of your horns you cannot wear helmets. (Press <w>%</w> to see a list of your mutations and innate abilities.)
messages.translation: 由于长有角，你无法戴头盔。（按 <w>%</w> 可查看变异和先天能力。）

messages.english: Only nagas and armataurs can wear barding.
messages.translation: 只有娜迦和犰狳人能穿身甲。

messages.english: Note that body armour with a high encumbrance rating may hinder your ability to cast spells. Light armour such as robes and leather armour will be generally safe for any aspiring spellcaster.
messages.translation: 注意：累赘值高的躯干防具可能妨碍施法。长袍和皮甲等轻型防具通常适合有志于施法的角色。

messages.english: Note that shields will hinder your ability to cast spells, until you've gained enough Shields skill to remove the penalty.
messages.translation: 注意：盾牌会妨碍施法，直到你的盾牌技能足以消除惩罚。

messages.english: Note that many ranged weapons are two handed and so cannot be used with an offhand item.
messages.translation: 注意：许多远程武器需要双手持用，无法与副手物品同时使用。

messages.english: The magic within can be unleashed by evoking (<w>%</w>) it.
messages.translation: 按唤发键（<w>%</w>）可释放其中的魔法。

messages.english: A manual can greatly help you in training a skill. After you pick one up, the skill in question will be trained more efficiently and will level up faster until you exhaust the manual's contents.
messages.translation: 手册能极大地帮助你训练技能。拾取后，对应技能的训练效率会提高，升级更快，直到手册内容耗尽。

messages.english: You can pick up a spellbook to add its spells to your spell library. (View your spell library with <w>%</w>.)
messages.translation: 拾取魔法书可将其中的法术加入法术库。（按 <w>%</w> 查看法术库。）

messages.english: Skeletons and corpses can be used as components for certain necromantic spells. Apart from that, they are largely useless.
messages.translation: 骸骨和尸体可作为某些死灵法术的材料，除此之外基本没有用途。

messages.english: This staff can enhance your spellcasting, making spells of its related spell school more powerful.
messages.translation: 这根法杖能增强施法，使对应魔法学派的法术威力更强。

messages.english: Miscellaneous items sometimes harbour magical powers that can be harnessed by e<w>%</w>oking the item.
messages.translation: 杂项物品有时蕴含魔法力量，可以通过唤发（<w>%</w>）使用。

messages.english: These nasty constructions can cause a range of unpleasant effects. You won't be able to avoid tripping traps by flying over them; their magic construction will cause them to be triggered anyway.
messages.translation: 这些危险的机关会造成各种不良效果。飞过陷阱也无法避免触发，其魔法构造仍会使它启动。

messages.english:
The dungeon contains a number of natural obstacles such as shafts, which lead one to three levels down. Once you know the shaft is there, you can safely step over it.
If you want to jump down there, use <w>></w> to do so. Be warned that getting back here might be difficult.
messages.translation:
地下城里有一些天然障碍，例如会让你坠落一至三层的竖井。一旦知道竖井的位置，就可以安全地跨过。
如果想跳下去，按 <w>></w> 即可。小心，返回这里可能很困难。

messages.english: Some areas of the dungeon, such as the Spider Nest, may be strewn with giant webs that may ensnare you for a short time. Insects, oozes and incorporeal entities can navigate the webs safely.
messages.translation: 地下城的某些区域（例如蜘蛛巢）可能遍布巨大的蛛网，能将你短暂困住。昆虫、软泥和无实体的生物可以安全通过蛛网。

messages.english: You can enter the next (deeper) level by following them down (<w>></w>). To get back to this level again, press <w><<</w> while standing on the upstairs.
messages.translation: 站在楼梯上按下楼键（<w>></w>），可进入更深一层。要返回本层，站在上楼楼梯上按 <w><<</w>。

messages.english: In Tiles, you can achieve the same, in either direction, by clicking the <w>left mouse button</w>.
messages.translation: 在图形版中，<w>鼠标左键</w>点击楼梯也可上下楼。

messages.english: You have not yet passed through this particular set of stairs.
messages.translation: 你还没有走过这处楼梯。

messages.english: These stairs lead out of the dungeon. Following them will end the game. The only way to win is to transport the fabled Orb of Zot outside.
messages.translation: 这处楼梯通向地下城外，走出去会结束游戏。只有将传说中的佐特宝珠带到外面，才能获胜。

messages.english: You can enter the previous (shallower) level by following these up (<w><<</w>). This is ideal for retreating or finding a safe resting spot, since the previous level will have less monsters, and monsters on this level can't follow you up unless they're standing right next to you. To get back to this level again, press <w>></w> while standing on the downstairs.
messages.translation: 站在楼梯上按上楼键（<w><<</w>），可进入较浅一层。这适合撤退或寻找安全的休息地点，因为上一层的怪物较少，而本层的怪物只有紧挨着你才能跟上楼。要返回本层，站在下楼楼梯上按 <w>></w>。

messages.english: In Tiles, you can perform either action simply by clicking the <w>left mouse button</w> instead.
messages.translation: 在图形版中，这两种操作也都可以用<w>鼠标左键</w>点击楼梯完成。

messages.english: Escape hatches can be used to quickly leave a level with <w><<</w> and <w>></w>, respectively. Note that you will usually be unable to return right away.
messages.translation: 逃生通道可让你快速离开当前楼层，分别使用 <w><<</w> 和 <w>></w>。注意，通常无法立即原路返回。

messages.english: To avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.
messages.translation: 为了避免自动移动或自动探索时误开某扇门，可以进入地图界面（<w>X</w>），将光标移到该格并按 <w>ee</w> 设置移动禁区。自动移动将不会进入该格，直到你再次按 <w>Xe</w> 取消移动禁区。

messages.english: This is your chance to join a religion! In general, the gods will help their followers, bestowing powers of all sorts upon them, but many of them demand a life of dedication, constant tributes or entertainment in return.
messages.translation: 这是加入信仰的机会！神通常会帮助信徒，赐予各种力量，但许多神也要求信徒奉献一生、不断献祭或取悦他们。

messages.english: This particular altar is so ancient that you cannot make out which god it is dedicated to! Converting here by pressing <w>></w> while standing on the altar will enter you into service of a random god, who will grant you some additional piety in thanks.
messages.translation: 这座祭坛年代久远，已无法辨认供奉的是哪位神！站在祭坛上按 <w>></w> 改信，会使你成为某位随机神的信徒，并获得一些额外虔诚作为答谢。

messages.english: An entryway into one of the many dungeon side branches in Crawl.
messages.translation: 这是通往地下城众多分支之一的入口。

messages.english: Beware, sometimes these can be deadly!
messages.translation: 小心，有些分支十分致命！

messages.english: Did you think you were the only adventurer in the dungeon? Well, you thought wrong! These unique adversaries often possess skills that normal monsters wouldn't, so be careful.
messages.translation: 你以为自己是地下城里唯一的冒险者吗？那可就错了！这些独一无二的敌人往往拥有普通怪物所没有的本领，务必小心。

messages.english: The ghost of a deceased adventurer, it would like nothing better than to send you the same way.
messages.translation: 这是一位已故冒险者的鬼魂，它最想做的就是让你步其后尘。

messages.english: This monster appears to be really dangerous!
messages.translation: 这只怪物看起来极其危险！

messages.english: This monster appears to be quite dangerous.
messages.translation: 这只怪物看起来相当危险。

messages.english: A berserking monster is bloodthirsty and fighting madly. Such a blood rage makes it particularly dangerous!
messages.translation: 狂暴的怪物嗜血而疯狂地战斗，这种怒火使它格外危险！

messages.english: Friendly monsters will follow you around and attempt to aid you in battle. You can order nearby allies by <w>t</w>alking to them.
messages.translation: 友好的怪物会跟随你，并尝试协助战斗。按 <w>t</w> 交谈可向附近的盟友下令。

messages.english: However, it is only <w>temporarily</w> friendly, and will become dangerous again when this friendliness wears off.
messages.translation: 不过，它只是<w>暂时</w>友好；友好状态消失后，它会再次变得危险。

messages.english: You can easily mark its square as dangerous to avoid accidentally entering into its field of view when using auto-explore or auto-travel. To do so, enter targeting mode with <w>x</w> and then press <w>e</w> when your cursor is hovering over the monster's grid. Doing so will mark this grid and all surrounding ones within a radius of 8 as "excluded" ones that explore or travel modes won't enter.
messages.translation: 可以将它所在的方格标为危险，避免自动探索或自动移动时意外进入它的视野。按 <w>x</w> 进入瞄准模式，将光标移到怪物所在的方格，再按 <w>e</w>。这会将该格及周围半径 8 格的区域设为“移动禁区”，自动探索和自动移动都不会进入。

messages.english: Apparently it has not noticed you - yet. Note that you do not have to engage every monster you meet. Sometimes, discretion is the better part of valour.
messages.translation: 它似乎还没有注意到你——暂时如此。你不必与遇到的每只怪物交战，有时谨慎比勇猛更明智。

messages.english: Apparently it has been distracted by something. You could use this opportunity to sneak up on this monster - or to sneak away.
messages.translation: 它似乎被什么东西分散了注意力。你可以趁机悄悄靠近，也可以悄悄离开。

messages.english: This monster doesn't appear to have any resistances or susceptibilities. It cannot fly and is of average speed. Examining other, possibly more high-level monsters can give important clues as to how to deal with them.
messages.translation: 这只怪物似乎没有抗性或弱点，不能飞行，速度普通。查看其他更强怪物的说明，可以获得应对它们的重要线索。

messages.english: (Melee oriented character with divine support)
messages.translation: （近战为主，有神力支持）

messages.english: (Magic oriented character)
messages.translation: （魔法为主）

messages.english: (Ranged fighter)
messages.translation: （远程作战）

messages.english: (erroneous character)
messages.translation: （角色错误）

messages.english: %s - %s %s: %s
messages.translation: %s - %s %s：%s

messages.english: That monster is %s. You can learn about any monster by hovering your mouse over it, and read its description by <w>right-clicking</w> on it.
messages.translation: 那只怪物是%s。将鼠标悬停在任何怪物上即可查看信息，<w>右键点击</w>可阅读说明。

messages.english: That %s is a monster, usually depicted by a letter. Some typical early monsters look like <brown>r</brown>, <green>l</green>, <brown>K</brown> or <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>.
messages.translation: 那个 %s 是怪物，通常用字母表示。初期常见的怪物有 <brown>r</brown>、<green>l</green>、<brown>K</brown> 和 <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>。

messages.english: An altar to %s
messages.translation: %s的祭坛

messages.english: This might be a good time to run away or apply your Berserk <w>a</w>bility.
messages.translation: 现在或许该逃跑，或使用狂暴能力（<w>a</w>）。

messages.english: This might be a good time to run away.
messages.translation: 现在或许该逃跑。

messages.english: You will then enter target mode with the nearest monster or previous target selected. Cycle through visible hostile monsters with <w>+</w> or <w>-</w>. Press <w>f</w>, <w>Enter</w> or <w>.</w> to fire. If you miss, <w>%s</w> fires at the same target again.
messages.translation: 随后会进入瞄准模式，自动选中最近的怪物或上次的目标。按 <w>+</w> 或 <w>-</w> 可在视野内的敌对怪物之间切换。瞄准后，按 <w>f</w>、<w>Enter</w> 或 <w>.</w> 发射。若未命中，按 <w>%s</w> 可再次攻击同一目标。

messages.english: First wield it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 先按 <w>%s</w> 持用它。

messages.english: First wear it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 先按 <w>%s</w> 穿上它。

messages.english: First put it on with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 先按 <w>%s</w> 戴上它。

messages.english: Open the ability menu with <w>%s</w> and select the corresponding ability. Activation may fail, especially without training.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 打开能力菜单，再选择对应的能力。发动可能失败，尤其是在缺乏训练时。

messages.english: You can also right-click your avatar.
messages.translation: 也可以右键点击自己的角色图像。

messages.english: When wielded, some weapons (such as this one) offer abilities you can activate.
messages.translation: 某些武器（例如这件）在持用时会赋予你可发动的能力。

messages.english: Wield this weapon with <w>%s</w>, or switch between weapons in slots a and b with <w>%s</w>. Adjust item slots with <w>%s</w>i.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 可持用这件武器，按 <w>%s</w> 可在 a 和 b 位置的武器之间切换。按 <w>%s</w>i 可调整物品位置。

messages.english: You've trained <w>%s</w> for a while, so consider continuing with it instead of <w>%s</w>. Press <w>%s</w> to see the skill values.
messages.translation: 你已经训练了一段时间的<w>%s</w>，或许应继续训练它，而不是<w>%s</w>。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看具体技能数值。

messages.english: Left-click a monster to attack it.
messages.translation: 左键点击怪物即可攻击。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire your ranged weapon.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 发射远程武器。

messages.english: To attack a monster, simply walk into it.
messages.translation: 要攻击怪物，只需向它移动。

messages.english: %s can be fired with <w>%s</w> without a launcher.
messages.translation: %s无需发射器，按 <w>%s</w> 即可投掷。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire, then <w>%s</w> to select this item.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 发射，再按 <w>%s</w> 选择这件物品。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> to fire and select this item.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 发射并选择这件物品。

messages.english: Your horns prevent you from wearing helmets. Press <w>%s</w> to view your mutations and innate abilities.
messages.translation: 由于长有角，你无法戴头盔。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看变异和先天能力。

messages.english: Only nagas and armataurs can wear barding.
messages.translation: 只有娜迦和犰狳人能穿身甲。

messages.english: Wear armour with <w>%s</w> and remove it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 穿防具，按 <w>%s</w> 脱下。

messages.english: Clicking its tile also performs either action.
messages.translation: 点击防具图块也能穿脱。

messages.english: Body armour with a high encumbrance rating may hinder spellcasting. Robes and leather armour are generally safe for aspiring spellcasters.
messages.translation: 累赘值高的躯干防具可能妨碍施法。长袍和皮甲通常适合有志于施法的角色。

messages.english: Shields hinder spellcasting until your Shields skill is high enough to remove the penalty.
messages.translation: 盾牌会妨碍施法，直到你的盾牌技能足以消除惩罚。

messages.english: Many ranged weapons require two hands and cannot be used with an offhand item.
messages.translation: 许多远程武器需要双手持用，无法与副手物品同时使用。

messages.english: Weapons and armour with unusual descriptions like this are more likely to have higher enchantment or special properties, good or bad.
messages.translation: 像这样描述不同寻常的武器和防具，更有可能拥有较高的强化值或特殊属性，可能有益，也可能有害。

messages.english: When worn, some armour (such as this one) offers abilities you can activate with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些防具（例如这件）在穿戴时会赋予你可发动的能力，按 <w>%s</w> 使用。

messages.english: Evoke this wand with <w>%s</w> to release its magic.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 唤发这根魔杖，释放其中的魔法。

messages.english: Alternatively, hold <w>%s</w> and <w>left-click</w> a monster (or yourself) and select a wand, or <w>left-click</w> the wand tile and then the target.
messages.translation: 也可以按住 <w>%s</w> 并<w>左键点击</w>怪物（或自己），再从菜单选择魔杖；或者<w>左键点击</w>魔杖图块，再左键点击目标。

messages.english: Read this scroll with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 阅读这张卷轴。

messages.english: You can also left-click it.
messages.translation: 也可以左键点击它。

messages.english: Put on jewellery with <w>%s</w> and remove it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 戴上首饰，按 <w>%s</w> 摘下。

messages.english: Clicking it in your inventory also performs either action.
messages.translation: 点击物品栏中的首饰也能戴上或摘下。

messages.english: When worn, some jewellery (such as this one) offers abilities you can activate with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些首饰（例如这件）在佩戴时会赋予你可发动的能力，按 <w>%s</w> 使用。

messages.english: Quaff this potion with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 饮用这瓶药水。

messages.english: A manual greatly helps train a skill. After you pick it up, the corresponding skill trains more efficiently until the manual's contents are exhausted.
messages.translation: 手册能极大地帮助你训练技能。拾取后，对应技能的训练效率会提高，直到手册内容耗尽。

messages.english: Pick up a spellbook to add its spells to your library. View the library with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 拾取魔法书可将其中的法术加入法术库。按 <w>%s</w> 查看法术库。

messages.english: Skeletons and corpses can be components for certain necromantic spells, but are otherwise largely useless.
messages.translation: 骸骨和尸体可作为某些死灵法术的材料，除此之外基本没有用途。

messages.english: This staff enhances the power of spells of its related school.
messages.translation: 这根法杖能增强对应魔法学派的法术威力。

messages.english: Since %s disapproves of magic, this staff is of little use to you. You may as well drop it with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 由于%s厌恶魔法，这根法杖对你用处不大，不如按 <w>%s</w> 丢弃。

messages.english: Some miscellaneous items contain magical powers you can harness by evoking them with <w>%s</w>.
messages.translation: 某些杂项物品蕴含魔法力量，按 <w>%s</w> 唤发即可使用。

messages.english: This weapon offers protection from certain damage sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这件武器能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This armour offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这件防具能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This ring offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这枚戒指能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: This amulet offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 这枚护身符能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: It also offers protection from certain sources. Press <w>%s</w> to view your resistances and other attributes.
messages.translation: 它还能抵御某些伤害。按 <w>%s</w> 可查看抗性及其他属性。

messages.english: You cannot memorise any more spells right now. This will change as you gain levels and Spellcasting proficiency.
messages.translation: 你目前无法记忆更多法术。随着等级和施法技能提高，情况会改变。

messages.english: You cannot memorise any spells right now. This will change as you gain levels and Spellcasting proficiency.
messages.translation: 你目前无法记忆法术。随着等级和施法技能提高，情况会改变。

messages.english: To cast a spell, hold <w>Control</w> and <w>left-click</w> a monster (or yourself), then select a spell. You can also switch to the spellcasting display by <w>clicking</w> its <w>tab</w>.
messages.translation: 施法时，可以按住 <w>Control</w> 并<w>左键点击</w>怪物（或自己），再选择法术。也可以<w>点击</w>对应的<w>标签页</w>，切换到施法界面。

messages.english: Press <w>%s</w> and choose a spell, e.g. <w>a</w> (check with <w>?</w>). For attack spells,
messages.translation: 按 <w>%s</w> 并选择法术，例如 <w>a</w>（按 <w>?</w> 查看）。使用攻击法术时，

messages.english: %s is harmless.
messages.translation: %s没有危险。

messages.english: %s is probably dangerous; stay out of it if you can.
messages.translation: %s可能有危险，应尽量避开。

messages.english: %s is currently harmless, but that could change. Check your resistances on the overview screen (<w>%s</w>).
messages.translation: %s目前没有危险，但情况可能变化。可在概览界面（<w>%s</w>）查看抗性。

messages.english: This cloud is opaque. You cannot see a square if two or more opaque clouds lie between you and it.
messages.translation: 这片云雾不透明。如果你与某格之间隔着两格或更多的不透明云雾，就看不到该格中的事物。

messages.english: Stand on the altar and press <w>></w> for information about <w>%s</w>. You will be asked to confirm before converting.
messages.translation: 站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，可查看<w>%s</w>的信息。改信之前会要求你确认。

messages.english: This altar is too ancient to identify its god, and %s probably will not like a change of allegiance. If you accept the risk, stand on it and press <w>></w> to serve a random god, who will grant some extra piety.
messages.translation: 这座祭坛年代久远，已无法辨认供奉的神，而%s大概不会喜欢你改换信仰。如果愿意冒险，站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，就会成为某位随机神的信徒，并获得一些额外虔诚作为答谢。

messages.english:
%s probably will not like a change of allegiance, but looking is safe. Stand on the altar and press <w>></w> for information about <w>%s</w>. You will be asked to confirm before converting and abandoning your current faith.
Press <w>^</w> to see your current standing with %s.
messages.translation:
%s大概不会喜欢你改换信仰，不过看看无妨。站在祭坛上按 <w>></w>，可查看<w>%s</w>的信息。在改信并放弃当前信仰之前，会要求你确认。
按 <w>^</w> 可查看你与%s的当前关系。

messages.english: You can also hold <w>Shift</w> and <w>right-click</w> your avatar.
messages.translation: 也可以按住 <w>Shift</w> 并用<w>鼠标右键</w>点击自己的角色图像。

messages.english:
Welcome back! If it has been a while, these screens can refresh your memory:
Inventory (<w>%s</w>)
messages.translation:
欢迎回来！如果离开了一段时间，可以查看以下界面，回顾当前情况：
物品栏（<w>%s</w>）

messages.english: , spells (<w>%s?</w>)
, abilities (<w>%s</w>)
, mutations (<w>%s</w>)
, religious standing (<w>%s</w>)
messages.translation: 、信仰关系（<w>%s</w>）

messages.english: , message history (<w>%s</w>), character overview (<w>%s</w>) and dungeon overview (<w>%s</w>).
messages.translation: 、消息历史（<w>%s</w>）、角色概览（<w>%s</w>）和地下城概览（<w>%s</w>）。

messages.english: Uh-oh, %s excommunicated you because your piety ran out. Perhaps you repeatedly broke the religious rules, did not please your god often enough, or both. Find an altar to %s to re-convert, and all will be well.
messages.translation: 糟了，由于虔诚耗尽，%s将你逐出了教门。也许你多次违背教规，也许你没有经常取悦神，或两者兼有。找到%s的祭坛重新皈依，就能恢复关系。

messages.english: If abandoning %s no longer seems wise and you want to return to your old faith, find an altar to %s and re-convert; all will be well.
messages.translation: 如果你觉得放弃%s并不明智，想重拾旧信仰，就找到%s的祭坛重新皈依，恢复关系。

messages.english: Otherwise you must endure this god's displeasure until their wrath is spent.
messages.translation: 否则，你就得忍受这位神的不满，直到神怒耗尽。

messages.english: Fortunately, %s does not seem to mind your conversion to %s.
messages.translation: 幸运的是，%s似乎不介意你改信%s。

messages.english: You even kept some piety!
messages.translation: 你甚至保留了一些虔诚！

messages.english: This alliance exists only among the three good gods; do not expect it to be the norm.
messages.translation: 这种联盟只存在于三位善神之间，别把它当作惯例。

messages.english: Fortunately, %s does not seem to mind your conversion to %s. As one of the good gods, %s usually forgives changes of faith, unless you take the path of evil, in which case retribution can be nasty!
messages.translation: 幸运的是，%s似乎不介意你改信%s。%s是善神之一，通常对改换信仰较为宽容；但若你走上邪恶之路，惩罚可就十分可怕了！

messages.english: %s did not appreciate your conversion to %s! What else could you expect from changing from a good god to an evil one? %s would have been more forgiving towards a god on the same side of the faith.
messages.translation: %s不喜欢你改信%s！从善神改信邪神，你还能指望什么呢？如果新神不站在信仰的对立面，%s本来会宽容得多。

messages.english: %s did not appreciate your conversion to %s! Usually only the three good gods forgive this kind of faithlessness.
messages.translation: %s不喜欢你改信%s！通常只有三位善神会宽恕这种背弃信仰的行为。

messages.english: Unfortunately, converting back would appease %s but annoy %s, so you must suffer the wrath of one god or the other.
messages.translation: 可惜，改信回去虽然能平息%s的不满，却会激怒%s，因此你总得承受一位神的怒火。
